cohort: The study involved 130 pregnant women between nine and 12 weeks of gestation receiving care at a tertiary care hospital in Chennai, India.
finding: A high Gestosis Score (GS >=3) was significantly associated with a higher incidence of pre-eclampsia and several adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: High GS was associated with higher rates of cesarean section.
birth_weight: reduced birth weight (2380 g vs. 2900 g)
gest_age: lower gestational age at birth (36.4 vs. 38.2 weeks)
